title: Derived internal Hom from the structure sheaf is the identity
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and assume its unbounded derived category $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ exists [def-pc-derived-category]. There is a natural isomorphism $R\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_Y}(\mathcal O_Y[0],-)\simeq\mathrm{Id}_{D(\mathcal O_Y)}$, for the shared derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom].

source.place: Section 08J7: derived internal Hom; specialization to O_Y[0] and evaluation at one

proof.text: Use homComplex_unit_iso to identify Hom(O[0], -) naturally with the identity on complexes. This groups the original evaluation and product-complex steps.

Apply derivedInternalHom_comparison to the functorial K-injective replacement I, with the proved quasi-isomorphism and K-injectivity properties. Curry the comparison at O[0]. Whisker the unit-complex isomorphism with I and Q. The resolution natural transformation becomes a natural isomorphism after Q; invert it. Compose with the associators and unitors to obtain Q followed by derived Hom from O[0] isomorphic to Q followed by the identity.
Apply Localization.fullyFaithfulWhiskeringLeft Q (quasiIso A (up Z)) to lift the composed natural isomorphism by preimageIso. The single complex and the derived single object agree definitionally.
